Summary answers (initial)
- SOC 2: Type II audit in progress; expected report Q1 2027 (controls mostly implemented, testing underway).
- HIPAA: We are a covered entity and will require a BAA for any solution that processes PHI. Scope may be limited to specific datasets — will confirm.
- GDPR / data residency: Primary production data is US-based (us-east). We do have EU patients for a pilot; if any EU-data processing is required we will flag that as a separate requirement.
- KMS/HSM: We prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for encryption-at-rest where supported.

Deployment options we are evaluating
- Preferred: Private VPC deployment in our cloud account with no public egress paths for inference nodes.
- Alternative: On-prem air-gapped install for a subset of workloads (especially PHI).

Open asks from our security team
1) Complete list of ports, outbound IP ranges, and required DNS names for firewall/Audit (we need these for our network team).
2) Example network topology for Private VPC + a sample on-prem air-gapped diagram (what components require control-plane connectivity vs can be isolated).
3) Clarify whether Redwood Private requires a persistent control plane connection or supports an offline control-plane for fully air-gapped deployments.

Hi Asha — copying technical answers and a starter topology image (attached). I’ll plan to go deeper during the tech call. Below are concise answers to the specific asks from your team.

Control plane connectivity
- Redwood Private supports two modes: (1) Private control plane with an encrypted management channel into your VPC (no public-facing IPs), and (2) fully air-gapped on-prem deployment where the control plane is customer-hosted and there is zero egress. The air-gap option requires an initial image install and periodic offline bundle updates (we provide signed bundles).

KMS / HSM
- We integrate with customer-managed KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and support HSM-backed key stores for on-prem. Keys are never exported from the HSM; our services use CMKs via standard KMS APIs.

Network / ports
- Minimal outbound: 443 to management endpoints (only for private-control-plane mode).
- For air-gapped: no outbound required; image bundles and signed binaries are delivered via physical/media or secured S3 transfer during maintenance windows.
- Inference nodes require intra-cluster gRPC and Redis/KV ports (we enclosed a simplified list in the topology attachment). See our public ports doc: https://redwood.app/infra/ports-and-ips

Data residency & logging
- Application telemetry and audit logs can be stored in your account and retained per your retention policy; we can push logs to your SIEM.

Next steps we can support
1) I attached a starter topology (proposed-topology-redwood-example.png) showing a Private VPC configuration and a separate air-gapped on-prem variant.
2) We’ll prepare a short matrix mapping each deployment variant to compliance capabilities (SOC2 scope coverage, HIPAA BAA compatibility, GDPR data flow notes) ahead of the tech call.
3) Confirmed: I am available 11/03 10:00 ET for the technical deep dive.
